title: Diesel engine quietness and fuel efficiency
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on diesel engine ownership mentions, with one clear positive note about quietness and fuel efficiency and several fragments that only state diesel experience without evaluative detail.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the diesel engine for strong fuel efficiency and a level of quietness not expected from a four-cylinder diesel.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments only mention prior diesel ownership or experience and do not express a clear view of engine performance or quietness.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the available examples are insufficient to assess sentiment beyond a single clearly positive comment.
Several fragments are simple ownership-history statements rather than direct evaluations of diesel engine quietness or performance.
